Noah C: PartnerOps asked for a compact enablement sprint: goal is a 30-40m "lab + packaging" session for CloudMarketplace submission. Need owners for demo, docs, and marketplace manifest.
Priya S: I can handle the quickstart docs and the submission checklist. Plan: short ref-arch (5m), live deploy (20m), packaging checklist + next steps (10m).
Gabriela M: I'll do the live Terraform demo. Keep the module minimal: VPC, instance, runtime config, and KMS flag. Demo flow: clone -> terraform init/plan/apply -> smoke test.
Noah C: Add a security blurb for private deployment (VPC peering + KMS). Partners always ask about key rotation and audit logs.
Priya S: I'll add a one-slide keyflow + IAM least-priv policy. Also drafting the marketplace manifest example (icon, description, support contact).
Gabriela M: Terraform snippet we'll demo:
```hcl
module "market_infer" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-refkits//cloud-marketplace/terraform/starter"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = "g4dn.xlarge"
  enable_private_vpc = true
  kms_key_arn = var.kms_key_arn
}
```
Noah C: Can infra create a short-lived partner sandbox for the rehearsal? Request name: cmx-sprint-demo-2026-02-12, creds TTL 36h.
infra-bot: Sandbox created: cmx-sprint-demo-2026-02-12. Creds TTL set to 36h. Rehearsal scheduled: 2026-02-11 14:00 UTC. Repo checklist: https://git.internal/redwood/partner-refkits/cloud-marketplace/enablement-checklist.md
Priya S: I'll open a PR with quickstart + manifest example by EOD tomorrow. Will include troubleshooting tips (security group rules, common AWS quota hits).
Gabriela M: I'll push the starter module and a tests/smoke/check_deploy.sh script. Will include a small alert rule example for token latency.
Noah C: Owners: Priya (docs + manifest), Gabriela (terraform + tests), Noah (coord + slides). We'll rehearse 24h before. Partner-eng, do you want us to include a short partner-facing handout?
partner-eng: Yes please  a 1-page handout with runbook and escalation path would be great.
Priya S: I'll add a handout file in docs/handouts/partner-onboard.pdf and link it in the PR.
Noah C: Great, post PR and rehearsal notes here when ready. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
